name: Greek Key
description: A running meander: one square-cornered line turning in on itself along every row, laid over tiles glazed in dark shades like a temple frieze.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color1); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--key); clip-path: @var(--key); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --key: polygon(0% 16.67%, 83.33% 16.67%, 83.33% 66.67%, 33.33% 66.67%, 33.33% 50%, 66.67% 50%, 66.67% 33.33%, 16.67% 33.33%, 16.67% 83.33%, 100% 83.33%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
